eye_colors._comment: Colors as [R, G, B] (0-255) or a CSS color name string. Only used when neopixels=true.

web_stats._comment: Serves a stats page (control mode, pause state, gait frequency, etc.) at http://<duck-ip>:<port>/, with a Shutdown button (POST /shutdown) to stop duck-startup without SSH. Also serves a phone-facing control UI at /control (joystick, buttons, IMU trim, walk tuning, eye color) backed by ControlBus.

imu_trim._comment: Residual IMU mounting-tilt correction (radians), tuned live from the /control web UI (or nudge programmatically) and saved here. Default 0/0 is a no-op regardless of mounting.

stability_governor._comment: Eases drive commands (not head commands) when tipping, BEFORE fall_detection would trigger — an additional, independent layer; fall_detection's pause+motors-off safety net is unaffected either way. Disabled (pure pass-through) by default. tilt_*_deg / rate_* are a lo->hi ramp; floor is the most-throttled command scale; smooth is the EMA rate.

_walk_tuning_comment: action_scale / velocity_clip / max_motor_velocity_rad_s are all live-tunable from the /control web UI. NOTE: velocity_clip is exposed/persisted for parity with the tuning UI but per-tick clipping enforcement is not implemented yet, so toggling it doesn't currently change motor behavior.

battery._comment: Optional overrides for the /control web UI's battery gauge (assumes a 2S LiPo by default). Voltage is read via HWI.read_battery_handoff() — a brief (~0.2s) servo-bus handoff to pypot, only while paused, throttled to every few seconds (see hwi.py).

remote_control._comment: When enabled, RLWalk listens for gamepad commands over UDP from the remote_control PC-side app instead of reading a locally paired gamepad. Leave disabled to keep using a gamepad (incl. Bluetooth) paired directly to the duck.

led_counts._comment: Number of NeoPixel LEDs wired to each segment of the strip, in strip order (projector, then right eye, then left eye). Only used when neopixels=true. Defaults to 1/1/1 if omitted.

led_brightness._comment: Per-segment brightness (0.0-1.0), applied once at startup. Only used when neopixels=true; out-of-range values are clamped. Independent from ODUCK_LED_BRIGHTNESS (the overall strip brightness env var) — this scales each segment on top of that.

_speaker_volume_comment: Playback volume (0.0-1.0), applied once at startup via Sounds.set_volume(). Only used when expression_features.speaker=true. Live-tunable/persistable from the /control web UI's Speaker volume panel.
_generic_usb_controller_comment: Optional: override axis/button indices for generic_usb or 8bitdo controller types. Run controller_info.py to identify indices.
